title: The Confidence Trap: Gender Bias and Predictive Certainty in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating token probability confidence calibration (using metrics like ECE, MacroCE, and a novel Gender-ECE) for pronoun predictions in template-based coreference resolution tasks (WinoBias, Winogender, GenderLex), comparing model confidence against actual prediction correctness and human bias annotations.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring calibration errors (ECE) using the WinoQueer dataset to evaluate model confidence and prediction reliability across marginalized LGBTQ+ identity groups (Gay, Lesbian, Trans, Queer) in a last-cloze sentence structure.
